i1.title: Estée Lauder Beautiful Eau de Parfum 75ml Gift Set with 10ml Eau de Parfum and 75ml Body Lotion
i1.descriptionHtml:
A romantic bouquet of a thousand flowers.

Estée Lauder Beautiful Eau de Parfum 75ml Gift Set with 10ml Eau de Parfum and 75ml Body Lotion brings together the iconic Beautiful Eau de Parfum, a 10ml spray for your bag and a perfumed body lotion. Rose, mandarin, lily and tuberose open in full bloom, a heart of orange flower, muguet, jasmine and ylang-ylang follows, and it settles on sandalwood, vetiver and amber.

  • Beautiful Eau de Parfum 10ml (spray)
  • Beautiful Perfumed Body Lotion 75ml

  • Heart: Orange Flower, Muguet, Jasmine, Ylang-Ylang
  • Base: Sandalwood, Vetiver, Amber

Why you'll love it

  • A lush floral opening of rose, lily and tuberose
  • A heart of orange flower, jasmine and ylang-ylang
  • A warm base of sandalwood, vetiver and amber
  • Three pieces, including a 10ml travel spray

FAQ

What does Beautiful smell like?

Rose, mandarin, lily, tuberose and marigold first, then orange flower, muguet, jasmine and ylang-ylang, finishing with sandalwood, vetiver and amber.
